requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity regarding 'medium-sized vehicles' resolved by controlled context glossary. Requirement structured as a single functional requirement using the supported interpretation (gross weight 1500-2000 kg).

source_fragments: All medium-sized vehicles shall be equipped with a navigation system.

fields.condition: vehicle gross weight is strictly between 1500 kg and 2000 kg

structured_requirements.final_statement: All vehicles with a gross weight strictly between 1500 kg and 2000 kg shall be equipped with a navigation system.
structuring_notes: Replaced ambiguous term 'medium-sized vehicles' with explicit weight definition from glossary.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific navigation system features, installation location, or activation logic.
